about_short_description.short_description: Relay is a workflow automation tool with a human touch.

product.name: Relay.app AI Agent Builder
product.description: A visual tool to create AI agents that automate workflows by connecting Gmail, Slack, Notion, and over 100 other apps.

product.name: Pre-built AI Automation Templates
product.description: Ready-made workflow templates that automate tasks like meeting briefings, sales qualification, LinkedIn content creation, and SEO tracking.

product.name: Human-in-the-Loop Workflow Features
product.description: Workflow steps that incorporate human review, approvals, and manual data entry within automated processes.

product.name: App Integrations
product.description: Integration with over 100 applications including Gmail, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Salesforce, and more to enable cross-platform automation.

product.name: Workflow Essentials and Automation Features
product.description: Tools and features such as paths, iterators, custom AI prompts, and webhooks to build detailed and flexible automation workflows.
